description: This file implements workflow execution logic within an approval management system. It manages starting workflows, progressing through steps, handling approvals/rejections, and assigning approvers to steps. The code integrates with a database via SQLAlchemy's async API and interacts with CRUD helpers and models related to approval workflows.

methods.name: _get_step_approvers_from_config(step_config)
methods.description: Utility to retrieve approvers list from step configuration json.

methods.name: _get_any_one_can_approve_flag(step_config)
methods.description: Utility to determine if 'any_one_can_approve' flag is set in step configuration.

methods.name: _create_instance_step_approvers(db, step, step_config)
methods.description: Creates approver assignment records for a workflow step when it is initiated.

methods.name: None start_workflow(db: AsyncSession, instance_id: int)
methods.description: Starts a workflow for a specific instance: initializes first steps and assigns approvers.

methods.name: None proceed_to_next_step(db: AsyncSession, instance_id: int)
methods.description: Advances the workflow to next step(s) after current approvals, handling sequential and parallel logic.

methods.name: None apply_approval( db: AsyncSession, instance_step_id: int, approver_action: str, variables: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, comments: Optional[str] = None, approver_id: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Records an approval or rejection action from an approver and triggers workflow progression.

ctags.name: apply_approval
ctags.signature: ( db: AsyncSession, instance_step_id: int, approver_action: str, variables: Optional[Dict[str, Any]] = None, comments: Optional[str] = None, approver_id: Optional[str] = None, )

ctags.pattern: /^async def proceed_to_next_step(db: AsyncSession, instance_id: int) -> None:$/
